title: Unconfirmed site connectivity outage
context: Several users report that an internal service is unreachable. A provider outage is suspected, but scope and monitoring evidence are not confirmed.

title: Suspected privileged account compromise
context: An unusual sign-in was reported for a privileged account. The alert is unverified and no incident lead decision is recorded.

title: Service latency with unknown cause
